decisions.reason: As a low-complexity, recurring care product that supports the firm’s flooring business, it is likely to stay in the range.
Maintenance oil is a natural aftercare product for wooden floors and strengthens the firm’s core flooring offer.
This niche care product fits the wood-floor portfolio, though its overlap with other care items makes discontinuation somewhat more plausible.
A moisture-protective underlay is a practical installation accessory for floor sales, even if it is a fairly standardized product.
High-density underlay foam complements flooring installations, but as a more commoditized accessory it carries a slightly higher rationalization risk.
Oak parquet is closely aligned with the firm’s long-established wood manufacturing capabilities and is the most strategic product to retain.
